On the correct unpermuted MNIST pixels, the LSTM performs better, achieving 98.2 % test accurracy versus 95.1% for the uRNN.
However, when we permute the ordering of the pixels, the uRNN dominates with 91.4% of accuracy in contrast to the 88% of the LSTM, despite having less than a quarter of the parameters.
